cohort: The study included 599 sexually active women who completed a web-based questionnaire at 6-8 weeks postpartum after giving birth at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, University of Szeged, Hungary.
finding: Educational level of the partner, previous contraceptive use, and frequency of sexual intercourse were significantly associated with effective contraceptive or LAM use at 6-8 weeks postpartum.
